registry_info.description: The display plate: one flat plate that fits a slot (footprint, flat rim as frame, floor or wall) and carries a content - a shader with parameters, a wallpaper domain tiled by a symmetry group, or a colour. On the floor it is walkable glass. The scaffolded playground is a structure of these.

display_plate.name: Display plate
display_plate.description: A slot-fitted plate with a content on its face: shader (path + params), wallpaper (group + repeats over a painted 4 x 4 domain) or colour. Floor: a thin walkable body with the content under the feet. Wall: stood up, its face into the room, posts when free-standing. Placed by a recipe's activities (place_activity) with slot_size, mount, content...; a gallery is a row of them.

playground_spec_hall.name: Playground spec hall / a place spec walked
playground_spec_hall.description: Compiles a playground place spec (places with their activities, framed boards - commons/modular/places) when it loads and builds it as a walkable hall, like the principal-places hall. A Void trial floor names the spec in its config {spec}; tools/playground_trial.py writes such trials, sized to hold every piece. The annex for what did not fit on floor 210 is the first (2026-11-02).
